title: M5 Faces, actions, binders, log, ink
description: Actions as step lists with preconditions and buttons; face layouts with show-when and collapsed face; binders, templates, working copies, drag-out copying, edit-template; example templates; log panel from op stream; freehand drawing and text. Implements DESIGN.md §4.5–§4.8, FORMULAS.md §8–§9. Done when every §10 fixture passes end to end in the UI.

title: M6 First session
description: Run DESIGN.md §8.4 start to finish. Scripted walkthrough plus a real playtest. Fix what is not pleasant. Done when the GM says it felt good.

title: M4 Canvas and objects UI
description: Browser tab client: infinite canvas, pan/zoom, multiple boards, objects with image/shape/text/facing/stacking/containment, inspector, formula bar, manual override, per-cell visibility, view-as mode, opaque zones. Implements DESIGN.md §4.1–§4.4, §4.6 (partial), §8.1. Done when prep steps 1–4 of §8.4 can be performed by hand minus binders.

title: M3 Protocol and MCP server
description: WebSocket op stream and command protocol shared by UI and agent; authority process serving localhost; MCP server exposing query, write, explain, subscribe. Implements DESIGN.md §5, §7 (platform). Done when acceptance scenario step 5 (agent authors a zone and a card) runs headlessly against the authority.

title: M2 Document and operations
description: Canonical schema, objects and cells, zones and boards, visibility cells, operation records with resolved effects, undo groups, snapshots, atomic save/load, schema migration, spatial index. Implements DESIGN.md §4, §7 (document, scale, persistence). Done when a document round-trips through the file format and undo of an op group is refused correctly after a conflicting op.

title: M1 Formula language
description: Lexer, Pratt parser, evaluator, values and coercion, dice and roll results, errors, operators, conditionals, functions, evaluation model. Pure package. Implements FORMULAS.md §1–§7. Done when every §10 fixture that does not need actions or spatial state passes.

title: M0 Scaffold
description: pnpm workspace, package skeletons (schema, formula, authority, ui, fixtures), TypeScript config, Vitest, lint, CI. Fixtures package holds FORMULAS.md §10 in machine-readable form. Ends when 'pnpm test' runs a trivial test in every package.

title: Polish
description: Standing epic. Review findings and ideas that are real but not needed for the current milestone. Triage into a milestone when it matters.

title: Multiplayer
description: Participants mapped to the characters they control, ordered server authority, rights model separating viewing, editing literals, editing formulas and actions, and invoking actions. (DESIGN.md §8.2)

title: Later
description: Standing epic. Items from DESIGN.md §8.2 and anything deliberately deferred past v1. Tracked so it stays in mind, not planned.
